name: @warpfield/wasm
description: warpfield codec (error-bounded, seam-free registration-field compression) in WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p warpfield-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile release-wasm && cp ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release-wasm/warpfield_wasm.wasm warpfield.wasm
